sloka: न हि राजा न जानीते कुम्भकर्ण नयानयौ।त्वं तु कैशोरकाद्धृष्टः केवलं वक्तुमिच्छसि ।। ६.६४.३ ।।
transliteration: na hi rājā na jānīte kumbhakarṇa nayānayau।tvaṁ tu kaiśorakāddhṛṣṭaḥ kevalaṁ vaktumicchasi ।। 6.64.3 ।।

translations.english: "Kumbhakarna! Although you are born of noble race, you are insolent, seeing your low intellect in all aspects you have no knowledge of what should be done or not to be done."
